## v1.9.1 — Crimson Flare theme

### Added

- **Crimson Flare** — vivid crimson light mode and deep obsidian cosmic dark mode with abstract light-flare wallpaper, preview thumbnails, and a dedicated icon pack
- Theme registered in the in-dashboard gallery and `ui/static/themes` manifest

### Upgrade

```bash
./update-amud.sh
```

Hard-refresh once after update, then select **Crimson Flare** under **Settings → Appearance**.

**Recommended:** `v1.9.1`
